request_summary: T9-CLV (Kris approved 2026-11-07 02:25): turn the 96,959 odds rows into CLV infrastructure - de-vig module (proportional + Shin, 1x2 trio, multi-bookmaker median consensus), closing-line extraction, CLV calculation functions, cross-bookmaker consistency validation. Prep layer for the DC/Pi-Ratings model phase.
scope_completed: Data model verified: afb_odds_snapshots holds ONE archived snapshot per (match, bookmaker) with selections 1/X/2 - OddsPortal historical pages expose the final pre-kickoff line, so the single snapshot IS the closing line (commence_time_utc is NULL on snapshots; kickoff date joined from matches)

clv_infrastructure.py: devig_proportional (multiplicative), devig_shin (Shin 1992 insider-proportion z solved by bisection, renormalised), clv_ratio (bet/closing-1), ev_vs_fair (bet*fair_prob-1) - reusable functions for the model layer

Computation tables created (no changes to existing tables): clv_closing_line (32215 rows - one per (match, bookmaker) with raw trio odds, margin, proportional + Shin de-vigged probabilities) and clv_consensus_closing (5431 rows - per-match median de-vigged probabilities across bookmakers + per-outcome dispersion)

Consistency validation delivered: per-outcome inter-bookmaker dispersion of Shin de-vigged probabilities - home median 2.02% / draw 1.29% / away 1.94% (p90 ~4.3%, max 27.9% outlier tail); proportional-vs-Shin consensus agreement mean |delta| 0.35-0.63% (max 3.94%) - methods agree closely, Shin retained as primary per quality

Coverage report: 5431/5478 matches (99.1%) have a consensus closing with >=2 complete-trio bookmakers; n_bookies low tail = 10 matches with 2 bookies, 135 with 3, bulk 4-8; 47 matches without consensus (16 incomplete 2-row trios + avg-only rows); 'avg' aggregate rows excluded (not a bookmaker, different selection labels)
No structural schema change: two NEW computation tables only, documented here; existing tables untouched

findings.title: De-vig quality validated via cross-bookmaker dispersion
evidence: Shin de-vigged probabilities across bookmakers: median max-min dispersion home 2.02% / draw 1.29% / away 1.94%; p90 4.33%/2.54%/4.13%
A tail exists (max 27.9% draw dispersion) - driven by low-liquidity bookmakers on minor matches; the median consensus absorbs it, but per-record dispersion is stored for filtering

findings.title: Proportional vs Shin: close agreement, Shin primary
evidence: Consensus mean |prop - shin| = 0.63% home / 0.35% draw / 0.51% away; max 3.94% home
Shin corrects favourite-longshot bias; both stored for the model layer to choose

findings.title: Coverage is near-complete with an honest small gap
evidence: 5431 matches (99.1% of 5478 with odds) have >=2 complete-trio bookmakers; zero single-bookie matches among complete trios
47 matches without consensus: 16 incomplete 2-row trios + matches with only 'avg' aggregate rows - listed as insufficient closing data per instruction

findings.title: OddsPortal archived snapshots ARE closing lines
evidence: Every (match, bookmaker) has exactly one snapshot trio captured at scrape time, years after kickoff for older seasons - OddsPortal historical pages expose the final pre-kickoff line for finished matches
No time-series exists, so 'last snapshot before kickoff' reduces to 'the archived snapshot' - documented as the de-vig input definition

actions_taken: Verified snapshot granularity, selection labels, bookmaker coverage
Built clv_infrastructure.py (de-vig module + extraction + consensus + CLV functions)
Created computation tables clv_closing_line + clv_consensus_closing and populated them
Ran consistency validation + method comparison + coverage report

verification.evidence: 32215 (match, bookmaker) trios inserted; 16 incomplete 2-row pairs excluded and counted
Shin: sum(p)=1 solved by bisection then renormalised; proportional sums to 1 by construction; spot-check clv_ratio(2.50, 2.20)=+0.1364, ev_vs_fair(2.50, 0.45)=+0.1250
dispersion percentiles stored per match; league-level medians reported

risks: Dispersion tail (max 27.9%) on low-liquidity matches - consensus uses the median so it is robust, but downstream CLV users should filter on disp_* columns for high-stakes use
47 matches lack a consensus closing (incomplete trios / avg-only) - these cannot support CLV and are listed as insufficient data
commence_time_utc is NULL on snapshots - closing is by-construction pre-kickoff (OddsPortal archive), but a future time-series odds source would need the kickoff join for true last-snapshot logic
recommended_next_actions: Model phase (DC / Pi-Ratings): consume clv_consensus_closing.p_*_shin_med as the closing fair probabilities; compute CLV via clv_ratio / ev_vs_fair in clv_infrastructure.py
Optional: add a coverage VIEW joining matches/clv_consensus_closing for the model layer's convenience
Optional: filter or flag the dispersion tail (disp_* > 0.10) as low-confidence closings
